title: All-Inclusive Greece Wedding Packages Compared
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW comparison guide. Compare 8 to 10 named Greek venue packages by WHAT THEY INCLUDE, side by side, never by cost. NO prices, fees, amounts, percentages, per-person figures, deposit sizes or 'from' prices anywhere; 'charged on top' or 'a fee applies' only where a venue says so. Say plainly what 'all inclusive' usually covers at a Greek venue and what it rarely covers, only as venues state it. Compare, don't rank: no 'best'.

OVERLAP (highest in the series): /destination-wedding-packages (live, 'All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages', generic all-inclusive intent); /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages (draft, owns 'greece wedding packages'); /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding-packages (draft, owns Santorini package terms). SEO checks volumes and rankings for greece wedding packages all inclusive and variants; if demand is tiny or merges with the head term, the run report recommends keeping this as a comparison page or folding it into the Greece guide. Link all three prominently.

Venue facts only from each venue's own official package page or brochure read live. Santorini package facts reused from content/posts/santorini-wedding-packages/03-source-pack.json (read live 2026-11-12) as part-5 (fact_500+). Venue paperwork offers only as the venue's own offer, once each; nothing implies the Wedded Advisor handles legal, church or religious paperwork. No transfer offers in copy.

Sections: intro; 4 one-sentence takeaways; what 'all inclusive' means at a Greek venue; the comparison table (venue and island, package, ceremony type, main inclusions, extras charged on top, requirements or minimums with no money) and a short entry per venue; how to compare two all-inclusive quotes like for like (inclusions in writing, per-guest or fixed as a question, deposits and cancellation, exclusive use and days, music times, weather plan, step-free access, quote currency); when all inclusive suits you and when to build your own; legal in brief (as at November 2026; link /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-venues legal section or the Santorini planning guide); Australian angle (one Advisor line: quotes in AUD for Australian couples, inclusions confirmed in writing; insurance as a question); FAQ; close.
AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk; 'often told' at most once; no hedge stacking; link each source once.

Links: /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages, /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding-packages, /destination-wedding-packages (all prominent); /destinations/europe/greece; island guides once each where relevant (/destination-weddings/crete-wedding-venues, /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding-venues, /destination-weddings/corfu-wedding-venues, /destination-weddings/mykonos-wedding-venues); /wonderland-concierge; /magazine. Do not use 'last dance' (brand-facts.md still contains it; never reuse that line); Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; one Advisor line in the body plus the close; no Wedded Privileges.
